title: Ring Neighbors Alert Status Mix
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ring:neighbor
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(alert_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Ring Neighbors alert feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `alert_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the overall mood of your Ring Neighbors alert feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
